# viettelcloud_volume_backup (Data Source)

Find one Viettel Cloud volume backup by ID or exact filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_volume_backup" "example" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Backup ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Exact backup name.
- `region` (String) Exact region name.
- `size` (Number) Backup size in GiB.
- `status` (String) Exact backup status.
- `volume_id` (String) Source volume ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Backup description.
- `disk_type` (String) Source disk type.
- `encryption_key_size` (String) Encryption key size.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the backup expired.
- `policy_id` (String) Backup policy ID (UUID), if any.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID (UUID).
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
- `volume_name` (String) Source volume name.
